name: The Void
description: Permanently banish one enemy Elite-or-lower Mob.

name: Unstable Power
description: Choose a Mob. Its Power becomes a random value between 50% and 150% of its original Power for its next battle.

description: Choose one Mob. Its Power becomes 150% of its original Power for its next battle, rounded down.

name: Lightning Strike
description: Transform a Pig into a Zombified Piglin or a Creeper into a Charged Creeper. Otherwise give the chosen Mob +10 Power for its next battle.

name: Respawn
description: Return the last Mob destroyed on your side to the first empty slot on your board.

name: Totem of Undying
description: Give the Totem to one of your Mobs. The first time it would be destroyed, it survives instead and the Totem is consumed.

name: TNT
description: Choose two adjacent Mobs. Destroy both.

name: Invisibility Potion
description: Choose one of your Mobs. It cannot be targeted until the start of your next turn.
